name: satori
description: Interactive architecture visualizer for Flutter/Dart projects. Achieve sudden enlightenment of your code structure.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run lint

satori.enableDebugLogs.description: Enable detailed debug logs (may slow down processing)

satori.audit.godClass.wmc.description: Audit: a class is a God Class when its complexity (WMC, the sum of the cyclomatic complexity of its methods) reaches this value. 47 is the "very high" threshold of Lanza and Marinescu, Object-Oriented Metrics in Practice.

satori.audit.godClass.atfd.description: Audit: a God Class must use MORE than this many attributes of other classes (ATFD). 5 is the top of "few" in Lanza and Marinescu.

satori.audit.godClass.tcc.description: Audit: a God Class must have a cohesion (TCC, the share of method pairs that use a common attribute) BELOW this value. 0.33 is the "one third" of Lanza and Marinescu.

satori.audit.weights.coupling.description: Audit: weight of coupling (how many classes it is connected to, relative to the most connected one) in the risk score.

satori.audit.weights.size.description: Audit: weight of size (members, relative to the largest class; a God Class counts as the maximum) in the risk score.

satori.audit.weights.cycles.description: Audit: weight of being part of a circular dependency in the risk score.

satori.audit.weights.violations.description: Audit: weight of layer violations in the risk score.

satori.analysis.exclude.description: Dart files left out of the analysis, as globs relative to the project (** crosses folders, * stays in one). Generated code is skipped by default: it is often most of the files of a big app, nobody reads it and it costs as many language server questions as written code. Use an empty list to analyse everything.

enumDescriptions: Ask Dart's analysis server where every symbol is used, one request per file (fast on big projects). If it cannot be used, ask the language server symbol by symbol.
Always ask the language server symbol by symbol (slow on big projects).
satori.analysis.engine.description: How Satori finds where each field and method is used.

satori.cache.enabled.description: Save the finished analysis of each project and reuse it while none of its Dart files changes, so opening a big project again takes seconds instead of repeating the whole analysis. Turn it off to always analyse from scratch.
